title: Protocol for DNA extraction from any plant species \(alkaline PVPP method)
protocol: Weigh out approximately 50 mg of fresh leaf.
Put the weighed leaf in a 2-mL sampling tube together with two metal balls.
Freeze the sampling tube in a deep freezer at -80°C for at least 1 hour.
Weigh up to 1 g of fresh leaf if extracting with mortar and pestle.
Cut the fresh leaf into small particles with scissors.
Add 1% 2-mercaptoethanol to PVPP buffer.
Mix by vortexing.
Pre-cool the MicroSmash.
Pre-heat the heat block to 60°C.
Cool mortar and pestle with liquid nitrogen.
Freeze leaf particles simultaneously with mortar and pestle.
Grind leaf particles thoroughly until they become fine powders.
Add fine sand when grinding hard leaves such as rice and camellia.
Shake sampling tubes at 2500 rpm for 30 seconds using MicroSmash.
Centrifuge briefly after shaking sampling tubes.
Add PVPP buffer in a ratio of 5-10 times the amount of leaf sample to ground material.
Grind again with mortar and pestle, recovering everything into plastic tubes.
When using MicroSmash, add 500 μL of PVPP buffer to samples.
Shake again at 3000 rpm for 30 seconds after adding PVPP buffer.
Heat in a heat block for 30 minutes.
Mix the tubes two or three times during heating.
Centrifuge for 10 minutes at 4°C and recover supernatant into new tubes.
Add one-quarter to one-half volume of PCI solution to supernatant.
Vortex mixture thoroughly after adding PCI solution.
Centrifuge at maximum speed for 2-5 minutes.
Recover water phase to new tubes after centrifugation.
Repeat PCI treatment step again on recovered water phase.
Dilute solutions with an equal volume of autoclaved water.
Add an equal volume of isopropanol to diluted solution.
Cool mixture in deep freezer for at least 10 minutes or freezer for at least one hour.
Centrifuge the cooled mixture for 45-60 minutes.
Recover pellet after centrifugation and remove all supernatant carefully.
Dry the recovered pellet with a hair dryer.
The white pellet is a mixture of DNA, RNA, and other impurities.
Dissolve pellet in water.
Add 1 μL of RNase-A stock solution.
Mix and put at room temperature or 37°C for 5 min.
Add twice the volume of ethanol, mix, and put in deep freezer for at least 10 min.
Centrifuge for 45-60 min and recover pellet.
Dry with hair drier and dissolve in water.
Estimate DNA concentration with NanoDrop.
Compare band intensities of extracted DNA with a series of different amounts of control λ-DNA.
Dissolve DNA in 3-mL TE buffer.
Add and dissolve 3-g CsCl.
Add ethidium bromide or GelRed.
Put 3.8-mL solution to each 5-mL tube.
Ultracentrifuge at 50000 rpm for 24-48 h.
Recover DNA band, and rinse with n-butanol for several times to remove ethidium bromide.
Precipitate DNA with ethanol.
